about: Zenkai Rules Z1 intent examples for PAR-cli-argparse-not-json (night-1 triage rank 3, scratchpad/night1-parity-install-guide-triage.md): argparse's own ArgumentParser.error() -- an unknown flag, a missing required argument, or the top parser's own leftover-arguments check -- printed plain text to stderr and exited 2, breaking scouter/cli/main.py's documented contract ('a plain invocation always gets JSON'). This affected 8 parity fails (2 P0: par-vocab.list-error, par-darkroom.undo_last-error). Run by tests/test_cli.py::ArgparseJsonErrorTest.
subject: scouter/cli/main.py _JsonErrorParser (build_parser)

examples.source: night1-parity-install-guide-triage.md PAR-cli-argparse-not-json: 'seven error variants with an unknown argument ... The CLI's argparse printed plain-text usage and exited 2, with no JSON'
night1-parity-install-guide-triage.md: par-darkroom.undo_last-error is one of the 2 P0 cases this fixes

review fix round 2, C-1 (finding 12): an unrecognized-argument error is raised by argparse's TOP-level parser, whose own _defaults never had _verb -- the old envelope said verb: null for every one of these (parity does not compare verb, so it never broke a case, but the field itself lied). Fixed: _JsonErrorParser.parse_args stashes the parsed namespace (which parse_known_args already filled with _verb) before calling error().

input.note: a REAL ScouterError (not an argparse usage error) keeps its own code/exit, e.g. wrong_view exits 4

examples.source: scouter/cli/main.py main()'s except ScouterError branch, unchanged by this fix -- only argparse's own error() path changes

triage item 14 (out of scope for the original fix, closed here per review fix round 2 finding 12): 'main.py:573 except ValueError emits outcome: "usage" rather than "error:usage"'. This is a verb fn's own ValueError (never argparse's), so _JsonErrorParser does not touch it -- fixed at its own except ValueError branch in main().
